label: Policy rate above neutral
rationale: The FOMC's own estimate of neutral. Available from 2012; counts as off before that

label: Banks tightening lending
rationale: More banks tightening than easing. Applied from the month after publication

label: Leverage phase
rationale: Spreads widening while stocks rise marks a market near its top

label: Risk-off phase
rationale: Stocks falling and spreads widening at the same time

label: Markets pricing cuts
rationale: Natural boundary. Market expectations move ahead of the policy rate

label: Labor market weakening
rationale: Rule of thumb. Fires 1-3 months after a recession starts, so it confirms rather than warns (false positive 2024-07)

label: Stocks break trend
rationale: Trends tend to persist. Noisy alone, so it only counts alongside vulnerability

label: Deleveraging phase
rationale: Spread peaks sat within +/-3 months of all 10 market troughs since 1990

label: Stocks regain trend
rationale: The mirror image of a trend break
